title: Rank2Replace: VLM-Ranked Slot Replacement for Out-of-Distribution Generalization
abstract: arXiv:2611.25834v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spurious correlations can give image predictors high in-distribution accuracy but poor generalization under distribution shift. We introduce $\textbf{Rank2Replace}$, which transfers knowledge of task-relevant evidence from pretrained vision--language models (VLMs) to small predictors through training-time augmentation for out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization. The VLM ranks object-centric slots by task relevance and guides rank-dependent replacement with same-rank slot embeddings from another image. This augmentation retains the original image's label, encouraging reliance on preserved task evidence as incidental cues change, and supports combination with existing OOD methods. Across four datasets and six splits under shared frozen slot embeddings, the default cross-entropy configuration reaches macro-averaged average-group and worst-group accuracies of $80.43\%$ and $65.28\%$ without environment labels or dataset-specific replaceme

translated_title: Rank2Replace：基于VLM排序的槽位替换实现分布外泛化
translated_abstract: 虚假相关性可以使图像预测器在分布内获得很高的准确率，但在分布偏移下泛化能力很差。我们提出了Rank2Replace，该方法通过训练时数据增强，将预训练视觉-语言模型（VLM）中关于任务相关证据的知识迁移到小型预测器中，以实现分布外（OOD）泛化。VLM按任务相关性对以对象为中心的槽位进行排序，并引导基于排名的替换，使用来自另一张图像的相同排名的槽位嵌入。这种增强保留了原始图像的标签，鼓励模型在偶然线索变化时依赖保留的任务证据，并支持与现有OOD方法的结合。在共享冻结槽位嵌入的四个数据集和六个划分上，默认的交叉熵配置在没有环境标签或数据集特定替换的情况下，达到了80.43%的宏观平均平均组准确率和65.28%的最差组准确率。
tldr: 该论文提出Rank2Replace方法，利用预训练视觉-语言模型按任务相关性对对象槽位进行排序并执行同排名槽位替换增强，在无需环境标签的情况下将任务相关证据知识迁移到小型预测器，显著提升分布外泛化性能。
en_tdlr: Rank2Replace leverages pretrained VLMs to rank object-centric slots by task relevance and perform rank-dependent slot replacement augmentation, transferring task-relevant evidence knowledge to small predictors for improved out-of-distribution generalization without environment labels.
